name: Rin
source:
Oiran Name: Chihaya (千早)

A commoner who became an oiran. She takes pride in her job and is extremely hardworking, showing outstanding knowledge in doctrines and arts of traditional performance. She got separated from her childhood friend at a young age, but continues to hold slight affection towards him.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/11/19/yoshiwara-higanbana/]Otome Jikan's character profile translations[/URL].]
